ED files chargesheet against Maharashtra 'godman' Ashok Kharat

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has filed a chargesheet against Ashok Kharat, a self-styled 'godman' from Maharashtra. The chargesheet details the allegations against him. This action by the ED is part of an ongoing investigation.
